ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MITHRIX.title: Mithrix Relic Configs
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MULTIPLAYER_FLAWLESS_HA:
Enables a unique version of Flawless Hammer for multiplayer with +1 cost, but giving an extra turn to ALL allies.
(Disabling uses the singleplayer version in Multiplayer instead.)
